highlights.title: How I work
items: I start by understanding the problem — business, users, and constraints — before jumping into code.
Frontend is my home base, but I happily cross into product design, architecture, automation, and AI-assisted development when the product needs it.
I use AI as a working companion: to think faster, explore options, and ship better software.

about.title: Hi, I'm Eva.
intro: I'm a Software Engineer with more than six years of experience building digital products.

I started my career focused on frontend development, but curiosity has always pushed me beyond that. Today I enjoy working across the entire product lifecycle—from understanding requirements and designing user experiences to defining technical solutions and delivering them to production.
What motivates me isn't writing code for its own sake; it's building products that solve real problems and create value for users.
Outside of coding, I'm constantly exploring new technologies, especially AI-powered tools that help me work smarter and deliver better software.
experienceIntro: Over the last six years, I've had the opportunity to work on fintechs, enterprise platforms, cloud solutions, and digital products.
My experience started in frontend development, evolved into technical leadership, and eventually expanded to product design, backend collaboration, automation, and software architecture.
Each role has taught me something different, but they all share one thing in common: building products that people actually use.
about.experienceNote: A short tour of the path — the full story lives in the resume.

jobs.summary: I led technical work across the product lifecycle — from discovery and UX decisions to frontend architecture, backend collaboration, automation, and shipping to production.

jobs.company: IUGO Software & Design Studio · Montevideo, Uruguay
jobs.summary: I built enterprise web apps for international clients, working side by side with designers, PMs, and engineers to ship scalable, user-focused products.
I delivered web and cloud platforms, touching frontend, infrastructure, data, and deployment — learning how products live beyond the browser.
I designed and shipped custom digital solutions from the first conversation about requirements all the way to launch.
